name: The Key to Scholomance
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.offerRewardText:
Well, here you are, adventurer - the completed Skeleton Key.  I am certain as I can be that this key will allow you within the confines of the Scholomance.  There's only one way to be absolutely sure it works, though.  Waste no time in trying it out, I say.

Good luck, mighty hero.  May your victories continue to bring you fame and power as you lay waste to Scholomance!
